location_qualifier: lower Lunga River / Lunga Road airfield area
source_locator: R2251: C25080307000 p. 2 (stamp 1308), 11th and 13th Construction Units in the lower Lunga River area on the morning of 7 August, and p. 3 (stamp 1309), withdrawal that night
current_activity: at the Lunga airfield when the US landing began
notes: JACAR 南太平洋作戦 第７編 (C25080307000 p. 2, stamp 1308) places the 13th Construction Unit, with the 11th, in the lower Lunga River area on the morning of 7 August 1942. The 13th’s own commander is not named on that page. The units withdrew on the night of the 7th to a naval headquarters position about 3 km west of the Matanikau (p. 3, stamp 1309). Confidence 0.5 (one Japanese official family; a Miller or Zimmerman page naming the 13th at Lunga on this date was not copied in this increment). Place is Henderson Field (PL4898). Coord reference R2224.
